say:1:1322209001:1.text: St. Kinga's Temple has been falling apart for years, and the recent heavy snowfall has pushed it to the edge. The beams could give way at any moment—thankfully, we've found craftsmen to start repairs right away.
say:1:1322209001:1.source_cn: 圣金嘉教堂年久失修，前些日子下了场大雪，现在房梁岌岌可...

say:2:1322209002:1.text: But we're desperately short on hands to find and move the building materials we need.
say:2:1322209002:1.source_cn: 可是教堂的人手太少了，根本搬运不来那么多建材。

say:4:1322209003:1.text: Really? That's wonderful! Your help would mean the world to us.
say:4:1322209003:1.source_cn: 真的吗？太好了！还请你们帮忙收集一些建材回来。
